title: Assurance calendar, handover and dependency synthesizer for compliance rollouts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Create a single source-of-truth schedule and handover process that synthesizes milestone dates, control owners, and downstream engineering dependencies for SOC2/ISO/SSO audit readiness. This ticket covers: 1) a canonical Assurance Calendar (calendar + JSON export), 2) Handover Matrix template (who owns evidence, who needs implementation signoff), and 3) Dependency Synthesizer—automated mapping from engineering tickets (ENG-*) to assurance milestones so PMs and security see real-time impact on gates. The deliverable must integrate with Confluence, the internal Calendar, and the Console release pipeline so handoffs can be blocked/unblocked by evidence tactics. Success metric: reduce manual evidence requests by 60% and reduce gate reopens due to missing audit artifacts by 40% during the next compliance wave.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical Assurance Calendar created and exported as both calendar feed and JSON snapshot
Handover Matrix template adopted by Security & PM with owners assigned for each control
Dependency Synthesizer maps ENG tickets to assurance milestones with at least 85% coverage for planned SOC2 scope
Alerting set up for missing evidence 14/7/3 days before milestone due date to owners
Integration demo completed in cross-functional readout and approved by Security lead
risks: Eng ticket metadata inconsistent (missing control tag) leading to incomplete mapping
Calendar export cadence mismatch with external auditor deadlines
Dependence on ENG-45821 (kernel scheduling) for auditable performance benchmarks
decisions: Emit an events webhook to Slack channel #assurance-alerts for missing evidence (approved 2026-02-25)
Prioritize SOC2 controls relevant to hosted API and auditlog retention for initial rollout
